concept: Full-body concept art of Cerberus, the monstrous three-headed hellhound of Greek myth, for a dark fantasy video game, seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on, in a symmetrical standing pose. It has the massive muscular body of a giant black dog with short coarse fur, scarred grey skin showing through, and glowing red eyes. Three separate snarling dog heads rise on three thick necks from its broad shoulders, the middle head facing forward and the two side heads angled slightly outward, with a clear gap between each neck. Rig-ready pose: it stands on its four powerful legs, straight and slightly apart, every leg clearly visible and separated from the others, and its long thin tail is held out behind it away from the legs. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible from head to feet. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: Cerberus, giant three-headed black hellhound with three separate snarling dog heads on thick necks, muscular body, short coarse fur, glowing red eyes, four powerful legs, long thin tail
garde: Keep the exact same creature: identical anatomy, proportions, colours and materials. Same plain uniform light grey studio background, same soft even studio lighting, same scale, the whole body visible, no floor, no cast shadow.
